name: 90805 · Long Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 90805 (Long Beach) has 194 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90805 (Long Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90805 (Long Beach) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
